description: Ministry of Education - A Degree awarding Status : CINEC Campus & Competent Authority : Gampaha Wickramarachchi Ayurveda Institute
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves legal/regulatory matters under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains two orders made by the Minister of Education: one amending degree programs for a private institution (CINEC Campus) and another appointing a Competent Authority for an Ayurveda Institute. Both orders are made under specific sections of the Act, representing regulatory actions and legal instruments rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganizations. The mention of the Minister's name is incidental to the legal authority being exercised, not the focus of the gazette.
